summary: Iter62 — Re-verification of the ONE HIGH-priority visual bug from iter61 (CTA modal portal escaping tenant theme-var scope) + full regression sweep. FIX CONFIRMED: CtaFormModal now accepts a `theme` prop and applies themeVars(theme) inline on the portal backdrop; PublicPreview passes site.theme through. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter61_cta_forms.py PASS in 10.87s (auto-provision 7 templates, industry field specs 6 templates + fallback, public submit + inbox lead, email-field protection, per-tenant isolation, rescan future-proof, client-editor simplified). Frontend computed-style evidence: LIGHT tenant Formcheck Medical (healthcare, primary #0D9488, radius 18, body DM Sans) — [data-testid=cta-modal-submit] backgroundColor = 'rgb(13, 148, 136)', modal backgroundColor = 'rgb(255, 255, 255)', modal borderRadius = '18px', modal fontFamily = 'DM Sans, sans-serif', body color = 'rgb(51, 51, 51)', modal backdrop --tp/--tbg/--tbody/--tbd/--tr/--thead/--tfb all resolve. Success badge backgroundColor = 'rgb(13, 148, 136)' and message contains 'Thank you! We\'ll be in touch within 24 hours.'. DARK tenant throwaway fitness (primary #EF4444, mode dark, bg #050506, radius 2, body Inter) — submit backgroundColor = 'rgb(239, 68, 68)', modal backgroundColor = 'rgb(5, 5, 6)', modal borderRadius = '2px', body color = 'rgb(229, 229, 229)', fontFamily = 'Inter, sans-serif' — proving the fix is theme-driven, not hardcoded. Modal contract regression: X close, backdrop-click close, Escape close, missing-required 400 -> [data-testid=cta-modal-error] shows 'Full name is required', submit label equals the triggering CTA label ('Book an appointment'). Throwaway dark tenant app_bca3b9038880 was archived + purged after the test.
critical_code_review_comments: CtaFormModal.jsx now sets style={themeVars(theme)} on the portal backdrop and uses `var(--tp, theme.primary)` / `var(--tbg, theme.bg)` fallbacks on the submit button, success badge and modal surface — a robust fix that also self-heals if the portal is used from another host that hasn't set theme vars.
The public submit path continues to write a message via inbox.new_message(form_label meta) AND a submissions row — good redundancy, unchanged from iter61.
cta_forms.py contract is stable — email removal still 400, unsupported field type still 400, rescan still provisions fallback for new qualifying labels.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter61 HIGH-priority bug is fully closed. The CTA modal now inherits every tenant theme variable (--tp/--tbg/--tbody/--tbd/--tr/--thead/--tfh/--tfb/--tsf/--tmut) because CtaFormModal wraps its portal in a div that receives style={themeVars(theme)}. Confirmed via getComputedStyle on both a LIGHT tenant (healthcare) and a DARK tenant (fitness). No open issues from the CTA modal form scope. Standard note: legacy suites test_iter11..52 hardcode dead ids and are expected to 404 — ignore.
rca of the issue: Fixed. Root cause was createPortal(..., document.body) placing the modal subtree outside the theme-var scope on <div data-testid=public-preview-page>. Fix applied in /app/frontend/src/components/CtaFormModal.jsx: the outer portal <div data-testid=cta-modal-backdrop> now carries style={themeVars(theme)}, so --tp/--tbg/--tbody/--tbd/--tr/--thead/--tfb/--tsf/--tmut cascade into all descendants (modal surface, labels, fields, submit button, success badge). Additionally, submit button and success badge use `background: var(--tp, ${theme?.primary})` so brand colour is guaranteed even if a future portal host forgets to set the vars. PublicPreview.jsx passes theme={site.theme} into the modal. Verified via getComputedStyle: light tenant submit_bg=rgb(13,148,136), dark tenant submit_bg=rgb(239,68,68); modal_bg switches from rgb(255,255,255) to rgb(5,5,6); borderRadius switches from 18px to 2px; fontFamily switches from 'DM Sans' to 'Inter' — all pure theme-driven.
